title: Monotonicity on B̄_{2r}(z) and finite mass of B_{2r}(z) give M_{B_ρ(x′)}(T) ≤ Γρⁿ uniformly near B̄_r(z) (preliminary P8, the mass hypothesis of (IBL))
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^P (= Euclid P), T ∈ 𝒟_n(U) (GeometricCurrentOn U n), z ∈ ℝ^P and r, Λ ∈ ℝ with r > 0 and Λ ≥ 0. Assume: (a) for all y ∈ ℝ^P and R ∈ ℝ with B̄_R(y) ⊆ B̄_{2r}(z), the function ρ ↦ ofReal(e^{Λρ}/ρⁿ)·M_{B_ρ(y)}(T) (values in [0, ∞]) is monotone on the open interval (0, R); (b) M_{B_{2r}(z)}(T) ≠ ∞. Then there are δ > 0 and Γ ∈ ℝ such that M_{B_ρ(x′)}(T) ≤ ofReal(Γ·ρⁿ) for every b ∈ B̄_r(z), every x′ ∈ B_δ(b) and every ρ with 0 < ρ < δ. Here M_W(T) = T.massOn W ∈ [0, ∞] is Simon's local mass, ofReal = ENNReal.ofReal, B_ρ(y) is the open and B̄_R(y) the closed ball.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (z : Euclid P) (r Λ : ℝ), 0 < r → 0 ≤ Λ → (∀ (y : Euclid P) (R : ℝ), closedBall y R ⊆ closedBall z (2 * r) → MonotoneOn (fun ρ : ℝ => ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (Λ * ρ) / ρ ^ n) * T.massOn (ball y ρ)) (Ioo 0 R)) → T.massOn (ball z (2 * r)) ≠ ∞ → ∃ δ Γ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ ∀ b ∈ closedBall z r, ∀ x' ∈ ball b δ, ∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → ρ < δ → T.massOn (ball x' ρ) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (Γ * ρ ^ n)
